name: playwright-tests-need-its-package
description: Playwright's test files are read through a convention row, so only a package that declares @playwright/test has them: there each project's own testDir and testMatch name its test files, read against the configuration's directory and matched as Playwright matches a pattern, anywhere below the test directory and without regard to case, while a Playwright configuration in a package that declares no Playwright enters no test file. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named playwright for the package @playwright/test whose range holds the installed version, which roots playwright.config.ts and reads the test files its testDir and testMatch, and those of each element of its projects, name.
